title: Frozen-source supersession ledger v1
description: Append-only record of frozen inputs of CLOSED research packets whose HEAD bytes have legitimately moved on. One entry per (path, frozen_sha256). The packet itself is never edited; the entry records where the frozen bytes still live and whether any research claim inherits across the change. Policy: docs/decisions/026-frozen-input-source-evolution.md.

binding.description: `inputs:<role>` for a frozen_input_identities.json row, `tooling:<key>` for a manifest.json tooling row.

kind.description: historicization: production source evolves, no research claim inherits; the packet becomes historical for this path. supersession: a successor packet re-freezes the evolved bytes and claims a relation to the CLOSED terminal; owner authorization required.

bound_by.description: Every packet binding that pins exactly (path, frozen_sha256). The checker recomputes this set and refuses an entry that lists more or fewer.

last_current_ref.description: A commit (never a branch tip) at which `path` still hashed to frozen_sha256. Must be an ancestor of HEAD; the checker re-hashes the blob at this ref.

claims_inherited.description: Always false for historicization. For supersession it is still false at ledger time: whether retained conclusions transfer to the new bytes is the successor packet's own claim to establish.
